notes: No starting section posted. The strategy says 'Start MPG + NR' and 'As a default, start ANSB' (starting Effects vary by matchup); starting is set to Hoth: Main Power Generators, Heading For The Medical Frigate and A New Secret Base. All are in the list and count toward the 60.
The list totals 59 as published (Locations 7, Effects 14, Interrupts 16, Starships 3, Devices 1, Characters 18); kept as posted.
Character sub-headings 'Spies (8)', 'EPP (8)' and 'Other (2)' were dropped as headers, not cards.

Posted 'Eco War Room' dested Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Eco Docking Bay' dested Hoth: Echo Docking Bay; 'Dagobah' dested the Light Dagobah system; 'Kiffex' dested the Light Kiffex (Jabba's Palace).

Posted 'Craken' (listed among spies) dested Colonel Cracken (Death Star II, 'Alliance spy and scout'); 'Lando w/ Vibrator' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Lt. Blout' dested Lieutenant Blount; 'Jeron Webb' dested Jeroen Webb; 'Momaw Naden' dested Momaw Nadon; 'R2-D2' (listed among spies) dested R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo), whose lore calls him a Rebel spy; 'Twaas Khaa' dested Tawss Khaa.
Posted EPPs 'Obi w/', 'Luke w/', 'Leia w/', 'Han w/' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Luke With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle and Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol.
